title: Record the odd-prime depth-zero unit root as a weight, not a padded-row reversal
body:
## Summary
- Executes the fitted callee's depth-zero unit ROOT at odd prime q=3 on a 64-atom body over F_3. All 64 incoming coordinates are the ring unit, and the parsed record is (64, 1, 0) with no STEP.
- The weight arm returns that unit and does not read the reverse flag or a row count, so this does not restore a padded row. The selected odd-prime machine check still uses the different root (256, 2, 1).
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/selected-odd-prime-unit-root/verify.py`
